status: DRAFT_NOT_IN_FORCE: config/independent_window_v1.json stays the prereg in force; apply this only at the re-freeze (members file), BEFORE tranche A is opened
change_from_v1: ONLY test.studentize: 'fixed' (v1 implicit) -> 'bootstrap_t' (Romano-Wolf 2005 eq. (11): sigma* recomputed on each resample). Reason: paper form; synthetic FWER at 5% closer to nominal (fixed sigma 5.25-6.0% / 11.4%, bootstrap-t 4.1-5.5% / 7.1%; ADR 0027). Stricter; alpha, members rule, tranches, cost unchanged. Decided by 동동 2026-10-22 ('추천하는 걸로 진행'), ADR 0030.
note: Fixed 2026-10-21 BEFORE any strategy was evaluated on these data (only archive download and the data quality gate had run). A new search family, separate from the BTC/ETH validation windows that were already looked at 7 times. A change needs a new file (v2) with a reason; a change after a tranche was opened never re-opens it.

independence.claim: time-disjoint: every read ends 2020-12-31, the day before runner.READ_START (2021-01-01). No DEV, validation, locked TEST or paper read in this archive covers 2020.
independence.not_claimed: Seed hypotheses were partly translated from older NEW2 research and the literature; that research may have looked at 2020 markets in other ways. Assets move together, so tranches of the same year are not independent of each other.

source.archive: Binance USD-M public monthly archive (data.binance.vision bucket, fetched through its S3 endpoint because the CDN host is blocked here)
source.fetcher: run/discovery/data_fetch.py --base-url <S3 mirror> (SHA-256 against the published CHECKSUM, quality gate, provenance)

market_cap_order.source: coingecko.com front page (rank by market cap), cross-checked with coinmarketcap.com for ranks 1-14
market_cap_order.excluded_kinds: stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USDS, USDE, DAI, USD1), tokenized/real-world assets and tokens without a Binance USD-M perpetual archive (FIGR_HELOC, WBT, LEO, RAIN, CC)

period.exits: every exit at or before the last bar of read_end (events that would end later are not taken)

eligibility.rule: a symbol is eligible when at least min_months complete months of 2020 have a kline file AND a funding file that pass the engine's quality gate (merged window and funding quality OK)

tranches.rule: BTC and ETH (their 2020 data was never read) plus the first 4 ELIGIBLE symbols of order_ex_btc_eth; an ineligible symbol is skipped and the next one in order takes its place
reserve: the next 7 eligible symbols after tranche A, in order. Not to be opened in the same decision as A.

members.rule: the validation candidates of one DEV-only evolve state directory, exactly as pipeline.validation_candidates() ranks them (DEV screen pass, capped DEV t, one per near-duplicate group), first max_batch_size of promotion_v3. Frozen to a members file (ids + canonical specs + context) BEFORE the tranche is opened.
members.transfer: every member's rule is applied to every tranche symbol, whatever symbols its own spec names
members.excluded_before_test: a member whose spec needs a dataset absent for 2020 (e.g. fng) is listed as excluded and is not part of the test family

cost.why: symbol-agnostic and more expensive than the BTC/ETH public estimate (2bp half spread + 3bp slippage + 5bp taker fee per side); no 2020 or alt order books exist here

test.statistic: per member, the equal-weight average over tranche symbols of the daily net return series (stats_mc.daily_series, bp, exit-day booking) on the common UTC-day grid [entry_start, read_end]
test.method: Romano-Wolf StepM (stats_mc.stepm, studentize='bootstrap_t'), H0: mean <= 0, one-sided
test.alpha_spending: tranche k (1-based, in the order tranches are opened) gets stats_mc.spending_alpha(k, 0.05); tranche A opened first gets 0.0304
test.pass: StepM rejects H0 for the member AND pooled events >= 60 AND at least 30 days with a non-zero pooled return
diagnostics_not_gates: per-symbol n, mean bp, HAC t

single_use: a tranche is opened at most once: a RESERVED marker is written before any strategy is evaluated, the window key is appended to run/discovery/validation_window_history.jsonl, and a key already in the history refuses the run
outcome_meaning: PASSED_INDEPENDENT_WINDOW is research evidence only. Cost stays unverified, so locked TEST, paper and promotion rules (ADR 0009/0010) are unchanged.
